description: Online booking (track B). Retention exception 4 of the no-delete rule: abandoned booking submissions and spent or expired one-time codes are hard-deleted by the hourly booking.purge job.

code.why: Retention exception 4: a submission still unverified 24 hours after it was made is deleted, so what a visitor typed into the form does not outlive the attempt. Verified submissions are never touched.
A one-time code that expired (or was spent) is deleted with the submission it served; it has no value afterwards and is never read for history.

ephemeralTables.why: Unverified public form data, deleted after 24 hours by booking.purge (retention exception 4 of the no-delete rule).
One-time codes live ten minutes; spent and expired rows are deleted by booking.purge.
